title: Vega Assault
summary: A compact mecha arcade shooter with shaded original pixel art, animated docking, three stages, distinct bosses and stereo chiptune music.
description: Defend Earth across three arcade stages with Screw Crusher, Double Harken and Space Thunder. Version 1.2.0 refines all 24 sprite frames with inked armor, articulated limbs, swept docking wings and distinct winged, carapaced and siege bosses. Includes transformations, multiple enemy families, attract mode and original stereo chiptune/SFX. Unofficial, non-commercial educational fan work; no traced anime/manga artwork, extracted sprites, production logos or soundtrack recordings are included. Third-party names and fictional properties remain with their rights holders.
